/.title: Wellness Bestie by ORIRI · Your wellness planner in Dubai
/.description: Your wellness, curated for you. Bestie plans your day in Dubai: where to move, what to eat and who to meet, around your energy, time and budget. Try it free.
text: Wellness Bestie by ORIRI is a wellness planner for women in Dubai that learns what works for you.
My favourites, free to explore: fitness studios to move, healthy cafés and meals, mindset podcasts and books, and meetups with the Stepsisters community.
Meet Bestie: Bestie curates where to move, what to eat and who to meet.

How it works: 1. Check in: share your energy, the time you have and your budget. 2. Get your plan: Move, Meal, Mindset and Meet up picks that fit your day. 3. Tap and Track: tick what you've done and close your rings. Bestie learns what works for you.
Try Bestie free for a day. No card, no app download.
